headline: Update flow learns to play per-version fixes — and decisions can now close.

items.prompt_template: When you say `update command room` now, I'll also check for any per-update fixes that apply to your workspace — surface anything you need to know about, announce new skills, run small repairs in the background. Every future update plays these automatically, and I only surface what actually applies to you.

Decisions you logged before now close themselves. When a new meeting transcript shows that something got signed / kicked off / 'went with', I write a decision-resolved note automatically. If you change direction (changed our mind / switching to / decided against), I mark it superseded. Conservative threshold — borderline calls don't act.
